saints.name: St. Martin of Tours
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The soldier who cut his cloak for a beggar, then left the army to become a monk and bishop of Tours…
biography: Martin, a soldier of the Roman army, met a shivering beggar at the gate of Amiens and cut his own cloak in two to clothe him; that night he saw Christ wearing the half he had given. Baptized, he left military service, founded one of the first monasteries in Gaul, and was made bishop of Tours against his wish.
He labored to convert the countryside and became one of the most beloved saints of the West; his shrine at Tours was a great center of pilgrimage.
saints.knownFor: Sharing his cloak with a beggar; monk and bishop of Gaul.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 11 November
